Add the grafana helm repo and inspect default values: `helm repo add grafana https://grafana.github.io/helm-charts && helm show values grafana/tempo | grep -A15 receivers`. Note that OTLP has empty endpoints by default — you need to set them explicitly.
The receivers are nested under `tempo.receivers.otlp.protocols`. Enable gRPC with `--set tempo.receivers.otlp.protocols.grpc.endpoint=0.0.0.0:4317`. Helm release MUST be named `tempo`.

Full command: `helm install tempo grafana/tempo -n dojo-lgtm --set tempo.receivers.otlp.protocols.grpc.endpoint=0.0.0.0:4317 --set tempo.receivers.otlp.protocols.http.endpoint=0.0.0.0:4318`. Then confirm the Service exposes those ports: `kubectl -n dojo-lgtm get svc tempo -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[*].port}'`.
